verdict.rationale: Zoho Books' own API uses OAuth 2.0 with documented client registration, access/refresh token generation, and a scopes catalog that gates access per module, so an agent can be issued module-scoped credentials. How fine-grained that least privilege goes is not shown in the evidence. Missing for 10: evidence of action-level scopes (read-only vs write), agent- or service-account-specific credential issuance, revocation/rotation controls, and independent hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can issue scoped/least-privilege API credentials for an agent

citations.quote: a scopes catalog gating access per module
